subject.title: feat(chat): UX-012 — token usage progress meter

question: Should this PR be retired as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/77670, or rebased into a distinct meter on top of the current context-usage surface?
rationale: The central UX is already shipped, but the PR is maintainer-labeled and a separate 2px meter is a product/design choice rather than an automatic repair.

options.title: Retire As Superseded
options.body: Treat the merged persistent context-usage surface as canonical and close or abandon this stale parallel branch.

options.title: Rebase As Design Variant
options.body: Rebase onto the current chat composer and add only a distinct meter that reuses the freshness-aware context model.

options.title: Pause For UX Direction
options.body: Keep the PR open until the UI/UX sprint decides whether the shipped context notice needs a second composer-level bar.

recommendation.title: Retire As Superseded
recommendation.body: Treat the merged persistent context-usage surface as canonical and close or abandon this stale parallel branch.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored both this PR and the merged persistent context-usage implementation, so they are the best available routing owner for the design choice.
